summary: Review chatbot, personalization and customer-data risks with practical AI governance exercises. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Ethical AI in customer engagement means assessing automated recommendations, chatbots and customer communications before they affect real interactions. For customer experience, marketing, data and compliance professionals, the course builds practical skills in mapping AI touchpoints, checking fairness and consent, documenting data provenance, and setting human-review and chatbot escalation controls using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, operate or govern AI-assisted customer interactions, including people who must explain automated outcomes across customer channels.
modules: OECD AI Principles for Engagement Decisions
Customer Journey Maps for AI Touchpoints
Consent and Data Provenance in Engagement AI
prerequisites: Working familiarity with customer engagement, marketing operations, customer service, data governance or compliance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use customer-AI scenarios and spreadsheet-based review; familiarity with Excel is useful.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
